skill.name: 3d-model-generation
skill.description: Generate 3D models using each::sense AI. Create 3D assets from text or images for games, products, architecture, characters, vehicles, and more with PBR textures.
skill.summary: Guide EachLabs 3D generation requests from text or image URLs, with session-based iteration and streaming response documentation.
skill.author: eachlabs

content.value_statement: Preparing detailed 3D asset requests requires clear visual and technical specifications. This skill guides EachLabs requests from text or image URLs, including quality modes and iterative feedback.
actual_capabilities: Provide authenticated curl examples for text-based 3D generation through the EachLabs API.
Show how to submit reference image URLs for image-to-3D requests.
Guide prompts for characters, products, furniture, vehicles, architecture, and game props.
Explain eco and max modes and session-based refinement across multiple requests.
Provide prompt guidance for polygon budgets, material finishes, and PBR texture maps.
Document streaming event fields for progress, generated output URLs, clarification, completion, and errors.
limitations: Requires internet access, an EachLabs API key, and sufficient service balance; no local generation engine is included.
Output quality, topology, dimensions, and requested formats depend on the remote service and require validation.
Image-to-3D examples require publicly reachable image URLs, so private references need an approved sharing method.
Provides documentation and request examples, not mesh editing tools, automated validators, or a complete streaming client.

use_cases.title: Prototype Game Props
use_cases.description: Draft low-poly prop requests with material descriptions and polygon targets, then refine related assets within a shared session.

use_cases.title: Explore Product Models
use_cases.description: Use an approved product image URL or text description to request a 3D model for visualization review.

use_cases.title: Develop Interior Concepts
use_cases.description: Describe furniture materials, proportions, and finishes to request models for interior visualization studies.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner: Describe One Object
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an eco-mode EachLabs request for a stylized wooden treasure chest with iron hinges. Show the request for review before sending.

prompt_templates.title: Intermediate: Use a Reference Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a max-mode image-to-3D request using [approved image URL]. Request accurate proportions and matte materials for product visualization.
prompt_templates.scenario: Translate a product reference into a detailed generation request.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: Refine an Existing Model
prompt_templates.prompt: Use session [session ID] to refine the sword model. Request deeper blade engravings and two color variations while preserving its proportions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Continue a model iteration using the same session.

prompt_templates.title: Expert: Plan a Coordinated Asset Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare separate eco-mode requests for a tavern table, barrel, and lantern using one session. Specify consistent style and a 5,000-triangle target per asset. Request 2K PBR maps and list checks needed before engine import.
prompt_templates.scenario: Coordinate multiple asset requests with technical review requirements.

output_examples.input: Prepare a low-poly treasure chest request in eco mode without sending it.
output: Request prepared for review; no generation submitted.
Asset: stylized wooden chest with iron hinges and weathered surfaces.
Mode: eco. Target: fewer than 5,000 triangles.
Review after generation: topology, texture appearance, scale, and engine import.

output_examples.input: Plan a headphone model request from an approved product image URL.
output: Reference: the supplied product image URL.
Requested model: headphones with accurate proportions, matte black surfaces, and leather cushions.
Mode: max. Intended use: product visualization.
Confirm image-sharing approval and service balance before submission.

best_practices: Specify object style, materials, intended use, polygon targets, and texture requirements before generation.
Confirm service cost preferences and image-sharing approval before sending a request; keep API keys out of prompts and shared logs.
Reuse the project session for refinements, then inspect downloaded assets before production use.
anti_patterns: Treating requested topology, formats, or texture resolution as guaranteed output.
Publishing confidential reference images or including API keys in generation prompts.
Submitting broad asset requests without confirming quality mode, budget, or review criteria.

faq.question: What do I need before making a request?
faq.answer: You need internet access, curl for the documented commands, an EachLabs API key, and sufficient service balance.

faq.question: Does this skill generate models locally?
faq.answer: No. It documents requests to the remote EachLabs service and does not include a local 3D generation engine.

faq.question: Can I use a reference image?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples accept image URLs. Use an approved, publicly reachable reference and avoid exposing confidential images.

faq.question: How do eco and max modes differ?
faq.answer: The guide describes eco for faster, lower-cost exploration and max for higher-quality work. Actual speed, cost, and quality depend on the service.

faq.question: How do I refine an existing model?
faq.answer: Send follow-up requests with the same session_id and describe the changes you want to make.

faq.question: Are all listed export formats guaranteed?
faq.answer: No. The guide lists GLB, GLTF, OBJ, FBX, and USDZ, but availability depends on the selected service model and generated output.
